ios.desc:
End-to-end encrypted email with zero-knowledge architecture. Your messages stay private, even from us. Every feature is designed with your privacy in mind, using NIST post-quantum cryptographic standards.

Terms of Use: https://secria.me/app-tos

quotes.text:
We just shipped mobile apps for Secria with full feature parity to web:

ML-KEM-1024 + X25519 hybrid encryption, one-click alias rotation, key exchange verification, tracker blocking, zero-knowledge architecture.

Coming soon: Secria VPN bundled into the Pro plan.

Happy to share early access links if anyone's interested.

Bugs welcome — we fix fast.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/secria-mail/id6756082980

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/detailsid=com.secria.webapp
quotes.story_title: Secria Mobile – Post-quantum encrypted email, now on iOS and Android
